lead.caption: An $81.3B debut: AI's league table, rewritten in a day.
lead.headline: Anthropic's $81.3 Billion IPO Rewrites the AI League Table
lead.summary: The biggest listing the sector has seen put Anthropic on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT — and turned nearly every employee into a paper millionaire overnight. Now a safety-first lab has to live with quarterly-earnings pressure.

on_this_day.text: NASA's InSight lander touched down on Elysium Planitia, Mars — the first mission devoted to studying the deep interior of another planet.
on_this_day.title: On This Day — 26 November 2018

stories.headline: US Proposes New Tariffs on 14 Partners; China Faces the Highest Rates
stories.summary: Washington's plan targets what it calls structural excess factory capacity. China would take an extra 20 points on top of existing duties of about 25%; Vietnam faces 20%. Beijing's foreign ministry responded on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Ballistic Missiles Strike Kyiv Late at Night
stories.summary: Explosions rocked the Ukrainian capital at about 22:46 on Wednesday. Mayor Klitschko urged residents to stay in shelters as air defences engaged.

stories.headline: Shenzhou-24 Crew Boards China Space Station in a First 'Space Handshake'
stories.summary: The Shenzhou-24 crew entered the station on Wednesday and joined the Shenzhou-23 crew on board — the first time a foreign astronaut has visited China's station.

stories.headline: Washington Weighs Targeting Iran's Leaders as Houthis Near Aden
stories.summary: US officials are again debating whether a strike campaign should target Iran's senior leadership to end the war, while Houthi forces close in on Yemen's interim capital, Aden.

stories.headline: China Urges Netherlands to Guarantee Fair Business Climate Amid Nexperia Row
stories.summary: China's foreign minister pressed his Dutch counterpart in Beijing on Wednesday to offer Chinese firms a fair, transparent and predictable environment, as the long-running Nexperia dispute continues.

stories.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Neon Tops LiveBench with a Million-Token Window
stories.summary: The mid-tier model beats OpenAI's Astra and Anthropic's Fable on LiveBench at $3 per million input tokens, returning Google to the top of the chart.

stories.headline: GPT-6.2 Designs Protein Mini-Binders — and the Wet Lab Confirms Them
stories.summary: OpenAI says its new model designed protein mini-binders by reasoning and code alone, with early experimental validation — general models are now being scored on verifiable scientific output.

stories.headline: Claude Ship Auto-Approves Routine Pull Requests
stories.summary: Anthropic's new beta reads a team's policy file, approves routine code changes on its own and routes the rest to humans. Claude artifacts can now also become standalone desktop apps in one click.

stories.headline: Willow Holds Logical Error Rate at 3.2×10⁻⁸ After 60 Correction Rounds
stories.summary: Google Quantum AI's 362-author surface-code study shows error rates staying stable over time, not just in a single snapshot. Separately, Q-CTRL demonstrated magic-state cultivation on IBM hardware at about a tenth of earlier error rates.

stories.headline: Traders Price an 85% Chance of a December Fed Hike
stories.summary: Rate-hike expectations pushed US bonds lower and weighed on AI supply-chain shares. The LME base-metals index has fallen 15% in November as copper, tin and silver retreat.

stories.headline: Thanksgiving Day in the United States
stories.summary: Thursday 26 November is Thanksgiving in the US — expect thin holiday trading and a short week on Wall Street.
